2609.20575.title: Accelerating Visual Policy Learning with Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control
2609.20575.paper_summary: Learning visual policies for locomotion and manipulation requires coordinating contact with the environment and can incur substantial computation and GPU memory costs. First-order policy gradients (FoPG) reduce training cost through differentiable simulation, but local optimization can converge to unintended contact patterns. To address this shortfall, we propose Sampling-Guided Policy Search (SGPS), which couples recurring action-target refinement by sampling-based model-predictive control with first-order policy optimization. Behavior cloning initializes the policy from sampled actions; training then alternates sampling-based refinement with short-horizon FoPG updates under perturbed initial states and randomized dynamics. For visual policy training, we use a decoupled FoPG formulation that excludes rendering from the computation graph, enabling direct learning from depth observations without a state-policy teacher. On a single GPU, SGPS learns policies for locomotion, obstacle traversal, crate pushing, and bimanual carrying on simulated Unitree Go2 and G1 robots. Our experiments further show that refinement improves policy learning beyond initialization and tracking alone. For hardware deployment, the distilled policy transfers zero-shot to a real Go2 and uses onboard depth to autonomously trot, crawl, clear hurdles, and switch between these behaviors.
2609.20575.paper_summary_zh: 學習運動和操作的視覺策略需要與環境進行接觸協調，並可能產生相當大的計算和 GPU 記憶體成本。 一階策略梯度 (FoPG) 通過可微分模擬來降低訓練成本，但局部優化可能會收斂到意想不到的接觸模式。 為了解決這一不足，我們提出了取樣引導策略搜尋 (SGPS)，它將基於取樣的模型預測控制的重複行動目標精煉與一階策略優化相結合。 行為複製從取樣的行動初始化策略；訓練隨後在擾動的初始狀態和隨機動態下交替進行基於取樣的精煉和短期 FoPG 更新。 對於視覺策略訓練，我們使用了一種解耦的 FoPG 公式，該公式從計算圖中排除了渲染，從而使我們能夠直接從深度觀測中學習，而無需狀態-策略教師。 在單個 GPU 上，SGPS 學習了模擬 Unitree Go2 和 G1 機器人的運動、障礙物穿越、箱子推動和雙手攜帶的策略。 我們的實驗進一步顯示，精煉在初始化和單獨跟踪之外改善了策略學習。 對於硬體部署，提煉的策略能夠無需訓練地轉移到真實的 Go2，並利用板載深度自主地小跑、爬行、清除障礙物，並在這些行為之間切換。
